About Infinidat

 

Infinidat is the standard in enterprise storage with industry-acclaimed solutions for primary and secondary storage. Our customers are among the biggest and most competitive enterprises and IT service providers in the world, for whom storage performance, availability, and cyber resilience are essential. Our global team of world-class engineers, developers, sales people, and business professionals is looking for talented individuals to join us.

 

Why Choose Infinidat
 

  • Each employee makes a difference on their team and contributes to the success of our company
  • You will grow professionally and personally in a supportive, collaborative working environment
  • Our innovative technical approach to enterprise storage makes for work that is challenging and rewarding
  • We’re a Gartner Peer Insights Customers Choice and recognized for high customer satisfaction
